collection.title: Mercedes-Benz CLA Coupe 2019 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz CLA Coupe 2019 Onwards (118) model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Specific Fit Mercedes-Benz arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. PLEASE NOTE - THE VF923 IS A SPECIAL ORDER PART - PLEASE ALLOW AN EXTRA 2-3 WORKING DAYS.

image.alt: Mercedes-Benz CLA Coupe 2019 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
